[**Under review at *The Lancet Public Health***]{.status-tag} · 2026

> *First comprehensive subnational analysis of deaths of despair across Europe, covering 170 regions from 23 countries. Three contiguous transnational clusters of stagnating or rising mortality emerged in North-Western and Eastern Europe, as well as Sweden. A clear north–south gradient is evident, with levels in Scotland, Lithuania, and parts of Poland exceeding those observed in the US.*
